title: Pad Nifty
overview:
Pad Nifty connects your Sega Saturn to NIFTY-Serve, the Japanese online service run by Fujitsu, using the Sega Saturn Modem and a telephone line.

Developed by Fujitsu, it gives the service a graphical interface operated with the control pad. Service charges from NIFTY-Serve and telephone fees apply.

- NIFTY-Serve access from the Sega Saturn
- Graphical interface driven by the control pad
- Requires the Sega Saturn Modem, a control pad and a phone line
- Memory backup support
